services.title: Baby & Newborn Photography in Durham
services.description: Gentle baby and newborn photo shoots in Sherburn Hill, Durham, with time for feeding, settling and cuddles. Explore photographs, packages and prices.
services.firstParagraph: From newborn days until your baby is sitting unaided, my baby and newborn photo shoots in Sherburn Hill, Durham follow your little one’s pace. I use wraps, outfits and props for a mix of styles, with plenty of time for settling, feeding and cuddles.

services.title: Maternity Photoshoots in Durham
services.description: Celebrate your pregnancy with a maternity photoshoot in Durham. Partners and family are welcome. Browse photographs, prices and advice on when to book.
services.firstParagraph: A little time to celebrate your pregnancy with a maternity photo shoot in my Durham studio, with your comfort and preferences at its heart. Partners and family are welcome at no extra cost, and you can choose two of my backdrops.

services.title: Family Photography in Durham
services.description: Relaxed family photography in Durham, in the studio or on location. Explore posed and playful portraits, package prices and options for larger families.
services.firstParagraph: Bring your favourite people together for a family photo shoot in Durham: a mix of posed portraits and relaxed, playful photographs, in the studio or on location. Individual portraits and two backdrop setups are included.

services.title: Portrait Photography in Durham
services.description: Studio and location portrait photo shoots in Durham for up to two people, or two plus a baby. Browse photographs, backdrop choices and package prices.
services.firstParagraph: A versatile portrait photo shoot in Durham, in the studio or on location, for up to two people or two plus a baby—from birthdays to simply spending time together. I combine a few posed portraits with natural moments, using two backdrop designs and props chosen around you.

services.title: Outdoor & Location Photography in Durham
services.description: Photography at home or outdoors in Durham and the North East. Explore location options, travel information and which photo-shoot packages are suitable.
services.firstParagraph: Your home, a favourite place or a seasonal beauty spot in Durham and the North East—I can help you choose a setting for most of my photography packages. Editing is included, so the weather doesn’t need to be perfect. Location shoots aren’t suitable for baby or cake smash packages.

services.title: Cake Smash Photoshoots in Durham
services.description: Celebrate a birthday with a cake smash photoshoot in Durham, with a styled backdrop and cake included. Explore prices and the optional milk bath splash.
services.firstParagraph: A birthday, a little mess and lots of personality: a cake smash photo shoot in my Durham studio. Recommended up to age four, with a backdrop styled around your ideas and an 8-inch cake in your chosen colour; the remaining cake is yours to take home. A 6-inch cake reduces the price by £10.

services.title: Baby Sitter Photoshoots in Durham
services.description: Celebrate your baby’s sitting milestone with a sitter photoshoot in Durham. Two themes, props and outfits are included. Browse photographs and prices.
services.firstParagraph: For little ones who can sit or stand with help but aren’t yet walking, my Sitter photo shoots in Durham celebrate their growing personality. Two themes are included, with props and outfits to choose from—or bring your own favourites.
